idea-plugin.name: Pi Coding Agent GUI
idea-plugin.description:
Pi Coding Agent brings the pi coding agent to JetBrains IDEs with a focused, streaming chat tool window, session persistence, protected tool output, editor and console context sharing, and configurable runtime settings.

Features
  • Chat with pi directly inside the IDE and receive streamed responses.
  • Persist and restore pi sessions across IDE restarts.
  • Create, switch, rename, delete, fork, and inspect sessions in a session tree.
  • Choose the active model and thinking level, and view token usage and context information.
  • Display protected tool output, including files, terminals, patches, and large-result summaries.
  • Open referenced files, URLs, and diff lines directly in the IDE.
  • Browse slash commands and reference project files with / and @ completion.
  • Compact context manually, configure automatic compaction, and abort automatic retries.
  • Attach selected editor text or selected console output as conversation context.
  • Paste images into the composer and send them with a prompt.
  • Support pi extension dialogs, notifications, status text, and widgets.
  • Follow the IDE light and dark themes automatically.
  • Configure the pi CLI path, Node.js runtime, diagnostic log directory, and panel shortcut.
  • Optionally play a sound when a task is completed.

Requirement: Install the pi CLI before use, for example with npm install -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent.

Source code and issue tracker: https://github.com/Cyber0xFE/pi-jetbrains-gui
